invariants.name: Core Environment Variables Defined & Strongly Typed
invariants.details: All 14 mandatory environment variables verified in Zod schema definition

invariants.name: Production Fail-Closed Boot Security Enforcement
invariants.details: Strict fail-closed boot aborts startup if weak JWT secret, dev key, or unapproved localhost DB is supplied in production

invariants.name: Database Fail-Closed Policy (Zero pg-mem Fallback in Production/Staging)
invariants.details: Client explicitly throws FATAL_DATABASE_ERROR if PostgreSQL is unreachable in production or staging (silent in-memory fallback strictly blocked)

invariants.name: CORS Security & Environment Scoped Origin Verification
invariants.details: Localhost CORS origins strictly gated by NODE_ENV !== 'production', live gateway preflight status: 204

invariants.name: Frontend Dynamic API URL Support (VITE_API_URL)
invariants.details: All 3 frontends (partner-platform, company-platform, landing-page) dynamically resolve API base URL from VITE_API_URL with safe fallback

invariants.name: Port & Vite Dev Server Proxy Mapping Consistency
invariants.details: Partner (5173), Company (5174), and Landing (5175) mapped consistently to API Gateway (4000)

invariants.name: Nginx Reverse Proxy Upstream & Static Asset Paths Integrity
invariants.details: deployment/nginx.conf proxies /api to docsearch-api:4000 without path stripping and resolves SPA static dist/bundle

invariants.name: Docker Compose Production Cryptography & Health Dependencies
invariants.details: docker-compose.yml specifies ENCRYPTION_KEY, JWT_SECRET, and healthcheck dependencies across all services

invariants.name: Health Probe & Database Mode Verification
invariants.details: API Gateway health check returns 200 OK with database mode 'EXTERNAL_POSTGRES' and 442 tables ready
